card.name: Openings of parentheses and section numbers
card.fires_on: Punctuation and digits just before or inside a parenthetical item, such as the space after an open parenthesis before a section number like 2.1 or 12.3, or an abbreviation in parentheses. Seen mostly in drug-label highlights and abbreviation lists.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The space or digit inside a parenthesized section number in label cross-references.

modes.label: Abbreviation lists and parentheses
modes.description: A parenthesis or comma introducing an abbreviation or its definition after a disease name.

modes.label: Numbers and linking words in dose text
modes.description: A digit inside a dose or count, or a word like to or stopping, in label sentences.
